📦 **ArtGallery `0022e48`** — art: curate six population-scaled pixel town map logos

Retain six individually generated white masters and exact built-in prompts/reference hashes. Derive binary-alpha 128px icons and inspect 40px light/dark previews. Pure architecture without circular badges or terrain bases; generic skyline symbols do not claim actual city fortifications.

Gallery build and --check pass: 1116 exhibits. Game integration follows in Blocksail.

Refs TASK-1076

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
